test.create_query: CREATE TABLE read_in_order_skewed_parts (key UInt64, part UInt8, payload String) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY part ORDER BY key
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO read_in_order_skewed_parts SELECT number, 0, concat('{"x":"', toString(number % 1000), '","y":"', repeat('v', 64), '"}') FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
INSERT INTO read_in_order_skewed_parts SELECT number, 1 + number % 7, '{"x":"1"}' FROM numbers(7000)
test.query: SELECT key FROM read_in_order_skewed_parts PREWHERE JSONExtractString(payload, 'x') != '' ORDER BY key FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM read_in_order_skewed_parts ORDER BY key FORMAT Null
